entities.summary: Chilliwack is a city with a population of about 7 people and an area of 261 square kilometres (101 sq mi) in the Canadian province of British Columbia. It is located about 100 kilometres (62 mi) east of the City of Vancouver in the Fraser Valley. Chilliwack is 34 kilometres northwest of the Sumas–Huntingdon Border Crossing on the Canada–United States border. The enumerated population is 7 in the city and 0.1 in the greater metropolitan area.
